The '''Red Cliff''' was a stone cliff located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Separated from the [[Scrap Ridge]] by a rock formation, the Red Cliff was located south of [[the Wound]], and a [[Abandoned Reclamation Service base|Reclamation Service base]] was located atop the cliff.<ref name="TOR:RP" />
